entities.summary: Desirae Marie Krawczyk is an American professional tennis player who specializes in doubles. She has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 7, achieved in August 2024, and has won twelve doubles titles on the WTA Tour, including the WTA 1000 Canadian Open in 2024.
